lead: A `covers:` marker added to a reject case moves every line number its `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` block names.
body: The marker belongs inside the `--FILE--` block, so a line inserted after `<?nvs` shifts every `case.nvs:N:C` below it by one, and the `-->` gutter widens by a space when a number crosses into two digits. Bump each location by the number of lines inserted, in the same edit, rather than waiting for the conformance suite to name them.
